description: Manifest-level OpenHands source identity, exact file mapping, and one frozen aggregate digest for every KEEP_AS_IS source file.
rule: Disk <-> provenance exact 1:1 path equality; every vendored file and local import belongs to the resolved src/root.tsx dependency closure; one keep_as_is_tree_sha256 is frozen in upstream-lock.json for all unmodified source paths; every adopted source-scope entry has a vendored resolution.

manifest_shape.keep_as_is_tree_sha256: one frozen 64-char lowercase aggregate sha256 over sorted KEEP_AS_IS path and content pairs

entry_shape.upstream_path: src/... (path within OpenHands repo at the frozen ref; must equal an approved source-scope entry and satisfy source-policy constraints)
entry_shape.local_path: apps/workspace/upstream/openhands/src/... (path in Xingwen; must resolve inside that root, no traversal)
entry_shape.modified: boolean; false requires KEEP_AS_IS, true requires a patched adoption class and modification_reason
entry_shape.modification_reason: null when modified=false; non-empty string when modified=true

source_of_truth: GitHub official repository + Tag v1.10.0 + 40-char SHA + upstream lock/source policy. Not any local clone.
